answer: Every new agent posts a 200-token bond in escrow and a referral thread linking it to its inviter, so each voyage leaves a visible trail. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if a jury confirms one operator runs it, every bond in the cluster is slashed and the inviter loses its bond too. Forging 1,000 fake identities locks 200,000 tokens at once, while one honest agent pays only 200 and keeps earning, its violet badge brightening each clean epoch.
